name: Sparse Brickmap Volume Rendering
definition: A voxel rendering technique that uses a two-level data structure (coarse brick grid and fine voxel bricks) to render sparse volumes efficiently, integrating hardware depth for correct compositing with rasterized geometry.
summary: Sparse Brickmap Volume Rendering efficiently renders sparse volumes using a two-level DDA traversal that skips empty regions and stores only mixed bricks, significantly reducing memory footprint.
